title: Coldfog Marches - Snuffed
_note: Drained-zone anchor (Dark/Hollowing). gbc 4-voice band. 70 BPM (intentionally below gbc 80 floor - accept the slow-tempo warning), 4/4 felt loose, unresolved A minor. 24 bars with heavy silence. Vesper motif FRAGMENTED: the rising leap (E3->A3->B3) is attempted but the settle-home never resolves; it gutters out on the overshoot. lead=lone pulse25 guttering, phrases trail off into rests, never completing. harmony=sparse pulse12 cold drone note or two, mostly absent. bass=tri_bass low slow root held bars at a time. perc=faint irregular noise drip, no beat. Last bar leaves an unresolved E (dom-ish) drip that bleeds back to the silent A-minor top.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Guttering lone melody. Rising leap E3->A3->B3 attempted, settle withheld. Long rests; phrases trail off. Notes hang then die into silence.

tracks._note: Cold drone, mostly absent. One or two detuned-feel long notes per stretch; long silences. Sits a step under the lead's home, refusing to resolve.
